ABOUT.TITLE: About Nagar Nudge
ABOUT.TAGLINE: Your city. Your voice. Your change.
ABOUT.INTRO: Nagar Nudge is a civic complaint management platform that helps citizens report local issues — roads, streetlights, garbage, water supply, drainage and more — and track them until they are resolved. Municipal teams and admins use the same platform to assign, progress and close complaints, so every report moves from a citizen's phone to a real fix on the ground.

MISSION.TITLE: Our Mission
MISSION.BODY: Make it simple for every resident to raise civic issues and easy for city teams to act on them — with transparent status updates from pending to in progress to resolved.

VISION.TITLE: Our Vision
VISION.BODY: A cleaner, safer and smarter city where citizens and local government work together, and no complaint is left unattended.
